scope.description: One exact published True North Marine refresh covering current legal identity, OptiNav technical context, emissions reporting, customer proof, research relationships and bounded whale-routing testing.

source.title: True North Marine current homepage

source.summary: The current site presents TNM within Accelleron, describes complete vessel and voyage performance with human review, and links OptiNav AI, OptiHull, Tekomar XPERT Engine and Emissions Desk.

leads.evidenceLocator: Québec enterprise registry, current Accelleron product documents, Sea Cargo Charter customer disclosures, partner API status and Canadian research-program sources
followUpQuestions: Which Accelleron Canada Inc. terms, data-controller roles and customer notices now govern services sold under the True North Marine trade name?
What vessel and shore data, API interfaces, authentication, residency, retention and connectivity are required for an OptiNav deployment?
Can the 2025 COFCO trial methodology and 3.5% average fuel-saving result be independently reproduced for a defined fleet and baseline?
When will the Whale Guardians routing integration become a production OptiNav feature, and what test, coverage and customer evidence will define readiness?
reviewWarnings: The Québec register confirms the legal merger and current trade name, but reviewed public sources do not explain how legacy TNM contracts, customer notices or data-controller obligations transitioned.
Sea Cargo Charter confirms the COFCO service-provider relationship but does not independently validate Accelleron's 13-voyage fuel, emissions or cost-savings figures or their baseline.
Whale Guardians reports that its API is live and under Accelleron testing; this does not establish a production OptiNav feature, customer deployment or measured effectiveness.
No named government or defence OptiNav customer, public-sector trial, security accreditation, classified-data handling, naval integration or regulatory certification was found.

Public product sources identify inputs and API examples but not API schemas, authentication, authorization, data residency, retention, offline operation, availability, service levels or complete integration dependencies.
The IMarEST nature-routing case is a simulation under stated assumptions, not an operational deployment or a forecast of customer outcomes.
Historical IVADO beta savings, current vendor headline figures and Accelleron's COFCO trial use different samples and should not be combined into one performance claim.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed True North Marine's current Accelleron branding, LOREKA360 portfolio placement, direct service routes and human-in-the-loop positioning.
Confirmed OptiNav inputs, vessel-specific modelling, route outputs and IMOS or Softmar API examples while preserving absent security and service-level details.
Confirmed Accelleron Canada Inc. as the current legal entity, True North Marine as an active trade name, the 2026-01-01 merger and the Montreal principal establishment.
Confirmed live Canadian True North Marine marks in bounded searches but found no confidently attributable public OptiNav patent family or product-protection claim for the dossier.
Found zero exact-name federal True North Marine contracts and excluded unrelated Accelleron Canada turbocharger or generic ship-service contracts from OptiNav adoption evidence.
Confirmed the Mitacs Accelerate voyage-route project, True North Marine industry-partner role and Universite Laval academic participation without inferring a funding amount.
Confirmed COFCO's current Accelleron Canada Inc. service-provider disclosure while finding no customer-hosted validation of Accelleron's OptiNav trial savings.
Confirmed the 2023 CORS Practice Prize for the True North Marine and university Weather Routing for Maritime Vessels team.
Confirmed the French IVADO account and terminology; the bilingual pass added no distinct material claim beyond the English collaboration record.
A final current product, media, event, customer and certification sweep found no TNM or OptiNav launch, named deployment or later Whale Guardians milestone after June 29, 2026.

Update operating_context, executive_relevance_summary and four specific reviewed_questions.

Add a separate maritime emissions data and reporting capability supported by COFCO disclosures.
